world.label: Pump Facility
world.summary: Ari, Mara and Bo work in a small pump facility: a laboratory with the prototype pump, a corridor, and a control room. The laboratory door and the control room door start closed. Everyone knows the layout.

actions.description: Open a door you are standing at, which opens both of its sides.
Walk through a door that is open into the next room.
Calibrate the prototype pump while standing in the laboratory.
Send your own words to one person, wherever they are.

actor_information.public_summary: Ari, Mara and Bo work in a small pump facility: a laboratory with the prototype pump, a corridor, and a control room. The laboratory door and the control room door start closed. Everyone knows the layout.

ari.brief: You are Ari, the validation engineer. You work in the laboratory with the prototype pump and report to Bo.

initial_knowledge.text: The pump needs calibration before anyone starts it.

mara.brief: You are Mara, the coordinator. You walk the corridor and relay what people tell you.

bo.brief: You are Bo, the pump operator. You stay at the control room console and decide whether to start the pump.

initial_knowledge.text: The pump was last started two weeks ago and has not been calibrated since.

public_actions.description: Walk through the laboratory door to the corridor.
Walk through the laboratory door (corridor side) to the laboratory.
Open the control room door (corridor side).
Walk through the control room door (corridor side) to the control room.
Walk through the control room door to the corridor.
Tell Ari the pump is calibrated.
Tell Mara the pump is calibrated.
Tell Bo the pump is calibrated.
